prompt: A long mooring line of round glass fishing floats strung on rope, floating on a calm open sea and crossing the whole very wide image from the left edge to the right edge, seen from slightly above: one main rope with only seven floats spaced far apart, and two thinner side ropes that split away from the main rope in a smooth curve, drift alongside it for a while carrying one or two floats of their own, and curve back to join it again at a larger float, like the branches and merges of a commit history.
